lines.x: Argentine shares trading in New York dropped approximately 3% as sovereign dollar bond markets highlighted investor concerns regarding 2027 debt maturities and financing reserves.
The Brazilian real approached 6 per US dollar, driving Argentina's bilateral real exchange rate down 13.7% in less than a month.
Argentina's official peso fell to a 12-month low of 1,565 per dollar while the informal street dollar rose 1.6% to 1,630.
Argentina's MSCI Merval index fell 0.3% and sovereign dollar bonds dropped 0.6%, driving the country risk benchmark up to 876 basis points.
